default._resident_note: 421,176 → 421,224 B (+48) and flash 1,166,192 → 1,185,668 for device-side map storage (#927). **Both figures are CI's, not the pinned host's** — the gate is the `embedded` job and it runs floating stable; CI linked exactly 421,176 on develop at 9bb7adf8 (run 30300503081), so the delta is a clean +48. The pinned local host links +40 for the same change (416,040 → 416,080 .bss), which is the usual few-byte layout difference between toolchains and the reason the ceiling is taken from CI. Itemized from an `llvm-nm -S` diff against 9bb7adf8 on the pinned host: `link::MAP_PHASE` +1, `link::MAP_RX_KIB` +4, `link::MAP_TOTAL_KIB` +4 (the map-transfer progress mirror the ride loop polls to drive the on-glass card); `SHARED_STORE` +12 (`Storage` gained `open_map_name: Option<ShortFileName>` — embedded-sdmmc refuses a second open of an open file, so the map catalog must read the loaded map's header through its live handle and needs its name to recognise it); `__embassy_main::POOL` +24 (the ride loop's new map-card reconcile block); `.L_MergedGlobals` +11 net re-layout. **No named compile-time allocation moved** — `app` is still 135,224 and `ble_object_store` still 13,528: the feature added module statics and one `Storage` field, and its `Screen::MapTransfer` variant is far smaller than the enum's largest, so `size_of::<App>()` is unchanged. Poll frame unmoved at 9,728 B.

floating_stable_observation._comment: Hand-recorded snapshot of what CI's floating-stable toolchain links; nothing regenerates it. SUPERSEDED as of #927: the profile figures above are now taken from CI directly (run 30306462532), so this block no longer carries the only CI datapoint. Kept for the trend it records — CI at 5eb3e72e linked 421,128, at 9bb7adf8 421,176, and with #927 421,224 — and for the point it was written to make: floating stable links the same resident set and the same poll frame as the pinned toolchain, differing only in flash.
